g.aria-label: Why Serving 100 Concurrent Users Requires Dynamic Batching
Serial Queue (1 Request at a Time)
Each request takes 2.0 s of batch-1 decode
(1,640 GB read from HBM; ALUs 98% idle)
High latency AND low GPU utilization!
Each decode step reads 16.4 GB weights ONCE
Bounded only by VRAM & TPOT latency SLO
Step Time for b Sequences of Context n: t(b) = (B_w + b · n · B_kv) / β
As long as b·n·B_kv ≲ B_w, adding concurrent users is nearly free in step time!
